channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nikola Mirotic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nikola Mirotic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Malone on Nikola Mirotic, Jerami Grant
item.description:
Malone:

“We have three games to go. How we're going to approach those games is try to get in a rhythm, monitor their minutes, Jamal, Michael, Nikola, Jerami have all played an extremely high amount of minutes This game is an opportunity for us to compete and get better....”

Michael Malone on Nikola Mirotic, Jerami Grant, Aug 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Josep Maria Bartomeu on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
barcacentre: Bartomeu:

“Mirotic for the basketball team? It is advanced, but I can not yet confirm his signing.”

Josep Maria Bartomeu on Nikola Mirotic, Jul 5, 2019. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
“How am I not in the top-100? You’ve got guys like [Nikola Mirotic, who was ranked 50th],”

Marcus Morris on Nikola Mirotic, Oct 10, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Dell Demps on Nikola Mirotic, Anthony Davis, Julius Randle
item.description:
Dell Demps on #Pelicans frontcourt featuring Davis, Mirotic and Randle:

“We think their games are all going to fit together... they are all unselfish.”

Dell Demps on Nikola Mirotic, Anthony Davis, Julius Randle, Jul 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Will Guillory:Jrue Holiday on Nikola Mirotic's performance tonight:

“He gave me the night off. I didn't have to score as much. If he's playing like that, then we're definitely hard to beat.”

Jrue Holiday on Nikola Mirotic, Apr 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Rajon Rondo on the difference a year has made for Nikola Mirotic:

“The energy around Niko is a lot better. I'm a big energy guy. I think it plays a big role in guys' development, guys' confidence on the court. The energy around him this year has been completely different.”

Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic, Apr 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic breaking out the last three games, averaging 28 pts:

“What I like most is he’s not just settling for the three; he’s getting it done in the paint as well, and cutting without the ball. He’s setting great picks, which is getting him open as well.”

Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic, Apr 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Rajon Rondo on new #Pelicans forward Nikola Mirotic, who was also a teammate last season in Chicago:

“He’s going to be a great addition to our team. He was a great teammate of mine last year. Great guy in the locker room. He’s going to play to win.”

Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic, Feb 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Rondo on Nikola Mirotic's breakout season:

“You’re only as good as your coach believes in you. This year he’s taken the next step, doing a lot of intangibles on the court, rebounding the ball well... I’m happy for Niko as a friend, and definitely happy to become a teammate again”

Rajon Rondo on Nikola Mirotic, Feb 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: John Paxson on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Darnell Mayberry:Paxson on getting a first-round pick for Mirotic:

“When Niko did come back, he played with great confidence and played very well. And because of that, I think his value was as high as it’s ever been.”

John Paxson on Nikola Mirotic, Feb 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
KC Johnson:Fred Hoiberg on Nikola Mirotic:

“He’s just so confident now. I truly believe that’s rubbing off on our entire team.”

Fred Hoiberg on Nikola Mirotic, Dec 30, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Sixers coachBrett Brown on Nikola Mirotic:

“When we study, 'What does a modern-day player look like?' It looks like him.”

Brett Brown on Nikola Mirotic, Dec 18, 2017. Source: Twitter @McGrawDHBulls.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Darnell Mayberry:Portis on Mirotic:

“I want to rekindle our relationship, try as best as possible,but I don’t control that right now.”

Bobby Portis on Nikola Mirotic, Nov 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Darnell Mayberry:Portis on Mirotic's reported ultimatum:

“I’m here to play basketball. I can’t control who goes. He goes, I go, I can’t control that.”

Bobby Portis on Nikola Mirotic, Nov 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
KC Johnson:Hoiberg on Mirotic:

“He said he’s watching all games and loves the effort guys are playing with. He’s been very positive in conversations.”

Fred Hoiberg on Nikola Mirotic, Nov 3, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Sam Smith:Wade on Mirotic:

“We just want him to be aggressive; we need him to win; it’s as simple as that; we need him to play big.”

Dwyane Wade on Nikola Mirotic, Dec 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.

item.title: Serge Ibaka on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
On the decision Spain has to make between choosing Nikola Mirotic or Serge Ibaka:

“I love Serge, he's my teammate. I would choose him because he can shoot the three, he blocks shots, and that's great in this League. But also Mirotic is a great player.”

Serge Ibaka on Nikola Mirotic, Mar 20, 2016. Source: Marca.com.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Hoiberg also said Nikola Mirotic had a good workout Friday as the forward is getting stronger following an appendectomy and follow-up surgery for a hematoma removal.

“(Mirotic) still hasn't really gotten out and pushed it on the floor as of yet, so I'd say Niko is a couple of weeks away,”

Fred Hoiberg on Nikola Mirotic, Feb 27, 2016. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Sam Smith:Thibs on Mirotic:

“The beauty of Niko is he’s not afraid; he’s been great and if he has a tough game he bounces back the next one.”

Tom Thibodeau on Nikola Mirotic, Apr 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Sam Smith:Gasol on Mirotic w/28:

“What Niko is doing right now with this team in the situation we are in I think is remarkable; give him credit.”

Pau Gasol on Nikola Mirotic, Mar 24, 2015. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
Sam Smith:Thibs on Mirotic:

“Paying great basketball; not much he isn’t doing. He’s playing very well defensively. He’s playing well offensively.”

Tom Thibodeau on Nikola Mirotic, Jan 6, 2015. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
“We have the rights to (Nikola) Mirotic... He's going to come either this year or the following year at the latest.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Nikola Mirotic, Jan 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @stevekylerNBA.

item.title: John Paxson on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
KC Johnson:Paxson on Mirotic:

“Our hope is that we'll get him over sooner rather than later. ... We view him as an important part of our future.”

John Paxson on Nikola Mirotic, Jan 7, 2014. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Gar Forman on Nikola Mirotic
item.description:
KC Johnson:Gar Forman on Mirotic's future plans:

“In our speaking with him, his desire and dream is to play in the NBA at some point.”

Gar Forman on Nikola Mirotic, Jun 27, 2011. Source: Twitter.
